name: searchTerm
label: Search Term
help: Keyword or phrase to search, from 1 to 50 characters. Either Search Term or Custom Search URL must be provided.

name: limit
label: Limit
help: Number of search results to return (max 100)

name: customSearchUrl
label: Custom Search URL
help: URL copied from a LinkedIn content search page after configuring desired filters. When specified, all filter parameters below are ignored entirely.

name: datePosted
label: Date Posted
help: Filter by when the post was published

name: contentType
label: Content Type
help: Filter by the kind of content the post carries

name: postedBy
label: Posted By
help: Filter by who published the post

name: fromMembers
label: From Members
help: Names of people whose posts to keep (e.g., Bill Gates, Satya Nadella). LinkedIn picks whichever person it ranks first for a typed name, which may be a namesake.

name: fromCompanies
label: From Companies
help: Names of companies whose posts to keep (e.g., Microsoft, Google). LinkedIn picks whichever company it ranks first for a typed name, which may be a namesake.

name: mentioningMembers
label: Mentioning Members
help: Names of people to look for in post text (e.g., Bill Gates, Satya Nadella). LinkedIn picks whichever person it ranks first for a typed name, which may be a namesake.

name: mentioningCompanies
label: Mentioning Companies
help: Names of companies to look for in post text (e.g., Microsoft, Google). LinkedIn picks whichever company it ranks first for a typed name, which may be a namesake.

name: authorCompanies
label: Author Companies
help: Names of companies the post author works at (e.g., Microsoft, Google). LinkedIn picks whichever company it ranks first for a typed name, which may be a namesake.

name: authorIndustries
label: Author Industries
help: Industries the post author works in (e.g., Software Development, Technology). Takes specific values available in the LinkedIn interface.
